issues.on_page: Exhibit A general receipts, under Taxes: 'Property tax relief' 1,370,356 (= p2 State receipts: GF 371,838 + R&B 998,518)
issues.issue: Under the category rules, the printed label 'Property tax relief' supports Property Tax Credit ('state property tax credit / relief'), not Homestead Exemption: no homestead line is printed anywhere in the trim. Against that, 998,518 of it is the Road and Bridge Fund's 'State receipts' (p9). Those are normally highway allocation, and Exhibit A doesn't count them as Public Works operating grants (Public Works shows only 92,826). No breakdown is printed. decision_needed[0] already asks the user; it is kept as state aid until they decide. detail[2] (371,838) and detail[57] (998,518) depend on the same decision.

issues.on_page: Schedule 4 row 'Interest on taxes' 446 (budget 252,000 on the same row); Exhibit A prints 446 as 'Interest on investments'
issues.issue: The row label supports Penalties and Interest on Taxes, but Exhibit A calls it interest on investments (Interest Income). The two printed labels conflict. The 252,000 budget is printed on this row, as recorded, but it looks like the fund's total budget.
